model: IMCC ideal associated solution: 46 melt species = 8 unbound parent oxides + 38 complexes; x_j = K_j(T) * prod_i (x_i*)^nu_ij; log10 K_j = A_j + B_j/T (T in K)
pack_arithmetic: FC87 Table 3 carries 36 complexes; SF04 adds 2 (K2Si4O9, KCaAlSi2O7) and revises 2 (K2SiO3, K2Si2O5): pack = 34 FC87 rows + 4 SF04 rows = 38

FC87.citation: Fegley B., Cameron A.G.W., 'A vaporization model for iron/silicate fractionation in the Mercury protoplanet', Earth Planet. Sci. Lett. 82, 207-222 (1987). DOI 10.1016/0012-821X(87)90196-8
FC87.table: Table 3, printed page 211 (fits); Appendix 1, printed pages 218-220 (per-reaction derivations)
FC87.domain_evidence: Abstract + body: vaporization computed at 2500-3500 K; nonideal magma runs at 2500, 3000, 3500 K

SF04.citation: Schaefer L., Fegley B., 'A thermodynamic model of high temperature lava vaporization on Io', Icarus 169, 216-241 (2004). DOI 10.1016/j.icarus.2003.11.023
SF04.table: Table 2, printed page 218 ('Revised thermodynamic data (log10 K = A + B/T)'; all four melt rows cited there to Hastie and Bonnell (1985))
SF04.domain_evidence: Section 2.4: 'We computed fractional vaporization with the MAGMA code over a wide range of temperatures (1700-3000 K)'; abstract: equilibrium vapor calculated 1700-2400 K for 109 lavas

transcription.method: dual independent passes: pass-a.csv (pdftotext -layout text layer of the author-posted reprints) vs pass-b.csv (visual read of 400-dpi renders, full-width page strips); field-level diff, then atom-balance validation of every row with fractional nu as exact rationals
transcription.diff_result: 0 field-level discrepancies across 40 transcribed rows (36 FC87 incl. 2 later-superseded FC87 K fits + 4 SF04); 3 pass-A OCR ambiguities (R16 B, R33 nu(K2O), R35 reaction) resolved by pass-B visual reads; see diff-report.md
